sentences.text: I mean, there's got to be an explanation.

alts.text: Gotta be a reason, right?
Surely there must be an explanation for this.

sentences.note: **there's got to be**는 '분명 ~가 있을 거야'라고 믿고 싶을 때, 이해 안 되는 일을 두고 하는 말입니다. **I mean**은 말을 고쳐 잡거나 덧붙일 때 앞에 가볍게 붙여요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 이번 승진 받으면, 이게 진짜 내 일이라고 인정하는 거나 마찬가지일 것 같아.
sentences.text: If I took this promotion, it would be like admitting that this is what I actually do.

alts.text: Taking this promotion would basically mean admitting this is my real job.
Accepting this promotion would be the same as admitting that this is truly what I do.

sentences.note: **it would be like admitting**은 어떤 선택을 하면 인정하기 싫은 사실을 인정하는 꼴이 될 때 씁니다. **what I actually do**는 잠깐 하는 거라 여겼던 일이 진짜 내 일이 되어 버렸을 때 나오는 말이에요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 1 | Friends

sentences.ko: 너 이거 못 해내니까 샘나서 그러는 거잖아.
sentences.text: You're just jealous because you couldn't pull this off.

alts.text: Admit it, you're jealous you couldn't pull it off.
I believe you are simply envious because you were not able to accomplish this.

sentences.note: **pull this off**는 어렵거나 아슬아슬한 일을 결국 해냈을 때 씁니다. **just jealous**는 친구가 괜히 트집 잡을 때 놀리듯 받아치는 말이에요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 걔가 우리 자리에 앉아 있던 커플한테 진짜로 소리를 질렀다니까.
sentences.text: He actually screamed at this couple sitting in our seats.

alts.text: The couple in our seats? He yelled right at them.
To our surprise, he shouted at a couple who had taken our seats.

sentences.note: **actually**는 '설마 했는데 진짜로'라는 놀라움을 담아 이야기를 전할 때 씁니다. **sitting in our seats**는 극장이나 경기장에서 내 자리에 남이 앉아 있을 때 그대로 쓰면 돼요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 나 방금 엄청 귀여운 간호사 두 명이랑 우리 데이트 잡았어.
sentences.text: I just got us dates with two unbelievably cute nurses.

alts.text: Guess what, I landed us dates with two super cute nurses.
Two remarkably attractive nurses have agreed to go on dates with us.

sentences.note: **got us dates**처럼 'get us + 무엇'은 나뿐 아니라 우리 몫까지 구해 왔을 때 씁니다. **unbelievably cute**는 '믿기지 않을 만큼'이라고 한껏 부풀려 자랑할 때 붙여요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.ko: 근데 걔가 너한테 먼저 물어봤으면, 그게 공평한 거지.
sentences.text: You know, if he asked you first, that's only fair.

alts.text: Hey, he asked first, so it's fair.
If he asked you before anyone else, then that is entirely fair.

sentences.note: **that's only fair** 는 '그래야 공평하지, 그게 맞지' 라는 뜻으로, 순서나 몫을 따질 때 씁니다. 앞의 **You know** 는 말을 꺼내며 상대의 주의를 끌 때 붙입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 아니, 난 우리 사이에 깨질 관계가 있다고 생각도 안 했어.
sentences.text: Look, I didn't think there was a relationship to jeopardize.

alts.text: I didn't know we even had a thing going.
To be honest, I did not believe there was a relationship that could be put at risk.

sentences.note: **jeopardize** 는 '위태롭게 하다, 망칠 위험에 빠뜨리다' 입니다. 문장 앞의 **Look** 은 해명하거나 선을 그을 때 '저기, 있잖아' 처럼 붙이는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 아, 살면서 이렇게 불편했던 적은 처음이야.
sentences.text: Oh, I have never been so uncomfortable in my entire life.

alts.text: That was the most awkward thing ever.
I do not believe I have ever felt this uncomfortable before.

sentences.note: **never been so uncomfortable** 처럼 'never been so + 형용사' 로 '이렇게 ~한 적이 없다' 를 말합니다. **in my entire life** 를 붙이면 '살면서 처음' 이라는 과장이 됩니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 8 | Friends

sentences.ko: 욕을 먹어도 이름이 알려지면 그걸로 남는 거야.
sentences.text: There is no such thing as bad press.

alts.text: Any press is good press.
Even negative publicity can ultimately be beneficial.

sentences.note: **There is no such thing as** 는 '~ 같은 건 없다' 로 단정할 때 씁니다. **bad press** 는 안 좋은 기사나 평판이고, 이 문장 전체가 '노이즈 마케팅도 홍보' 라는 뜻의 굳은 말입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 8 | Friends

sentences.ko: 그리고 나 지금은 그냥 좀 혼자 있고 싶어.
sentences.text: And I I just kind of want to be alone right now.

alts.text: I need some space right now.
At the moment, I would simply prefer to be by myself.

sentences.note: **kind of want to** 는 '좀 ~하고 싶어' 로 부탁을 부드럽게 할 때 씁니다. 상대를 밀어내지 않고 혼자 있고 싶다고 말할 때 **be alone** 과 함께 자주 나옵니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends
